title: Natural rational representations on scalar extensions
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $G$ an affine $k$-group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme], and $V$ a $k$-vector space. Put $V_R=R\otimes_k V$ using [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. For every commutative $k$-algebra $R$, put $G(R)=\operatorname{Hom}_k(\operatorname{Spec}R,G)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. A natural rational representation on $V$ is a family of group homomorphisms $r_R:G(R)\to\operatorname{Aut}_R(V_R)$ such that for every $k$-algebra map $\alpha:R\to T$, every $g\in G(R)$ and every $z\in V_R$, one has $(\alpha\otimes1)(r_R(g)z)=r_T(G(\alpha)(g))((\alpha\otimes1)z)$. The scalar action on $V_R$ is on its first tensor factor. All the individual objects lie in one fixed universe; the family may lie in the containing universe.
